absence_redistribution.semantics: conditional on the Phase 5B known absence set; not a main-model input

expected_usage_model.target: bounded traditional USG%; raw USG retained for audit

protocol.distribution_selection: retain a Phase 6C component only for chronological probabilistic improvement without unacceptable central degradation
protocol.family_selection: independent inner-chronological ablations first; combine only families with positive inner incremental value; outer rows are evaluation only
protocol.usage_oof_policy: for target season Y, train before Y-1, select iterations on Y-1, and predict Y; target-game usage is never a downstream input

selection_gate.rule: selected on inner MAE with inner RMSE guard; accepted only if outer pooled MAE improves, RMSE is within 0.2%, and |bias|<=0.25
